subject: Next steps + legal routing for NDA/MSA/DPA
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>, Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@acme.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps + legal routing for NDA/MSA/DPA

Hi Priya / Tom 

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so were aligned: 

- Key stakeholders we heard today:
  - Economic buyer: Tom Nguyen (VP, Platform)
  - Procurement: Priya Shah (Sr. Procurement Manager)
  - Security: Acme security team (SOC 2 + architecture review requested)
  - Legal owner for contracts: TBD (Priya, please confirm who on your legal team will own NDA/MSA/DPA routing)

- Decision criteria you called out: latency SLOs, data residency (US), and vendor security posture (SOC 2 Type II).

Proposed redline/turn sequence (to avoid blocking):
1) NDA first (covers initial evaluation data sharing)  weve attached a short NDA draft for your legal to review (attachment: NDA-first-draft.docx).
2) DPA concurrently for data handling specifics.
3) MSA + pricing SOW last; redlines to MSA often take the longest so we can start clause-level negotiation early.

Questions / asks for Acme: 
- Who is the primary legal contact for NDA vs MSA (name + email)?
- Typical turn time for NDA review and for MSA redlines?
- Any procurement portals or PO requirements we should know about?

Internal ask: looping in David (Legal) to start prepping standard DPA language and Markus/Monica for commercial considerations.

Proposed dates: if we can get NDA comments by end of next week (2026-07-26), we’ll circulate redline_v1 back to you the following week. Happy to block 30 minutes for a redline walk-through if helpful.

Thanks 

Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference

Attachments: NDA-first-draft.docx (Microsoft Word document, 28 KB)

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@acme.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T12:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps + legal routing for NDA/MSA/DPA

Marissa 

Thanks for the clear summary. This aligns with what we discussed. A few notes from procurement/legal side: 

- Ill own routing through procurement. My counterpart in legal is Sarah Lin (sarah.lin@acme.com)  Im looping her on the thread. (Note: I did not add Sarah here in case she prefers to be invited after we confirm scope.)
- Typical turn times: NDA  35 business days; MSA redlines  714 business days depending on how many commercial terms are changed.
- We will need SOC 2 Type II report and a high-level architecture diagram for the security review.
- We do have a vendor onboarding portal (procure.acme.com). We can create a vendor profile once paperwork is received.

Ill aim to get initial NDA comments by 2026-07-24. If you can share the DPA template, that’ll speed parallel review.

Appreciate the proposed sequencing  sounds good.

Best,
Priya Shah
Sr. Procurement Manager, Acme Cloud Services
priya.shah@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T13:10:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Next steps + legal routing for NDA/MSA/DPA

Team  forwarding Priyas reply. Quick internal notes: 

- Priya will route through procurement and says turn times: NDA 35bd, MSA 714bd.
- They need SOC 2 Type II and an architecture diagram for security.
- Priya named a legal contact (Sarah Lin) but didn’t want her looped until we confirm scope.

David  can you prep a short DPA template and a SOC 2 summary doc we can hand to them? Also, if you want to pre-populate any MSA clauses we typically flag for commercial review (data residency, liability caps), please drop them here and Markus/Monica and I will align.

Markus/Monica  FYI on the timeline; likely next steps will require an initial credit/pricing review if they ask for custom SLOs.

Thanks 
Marissa

Hi Priya / Tom 

Following up  weve attached our first round of redlines for the NDA (redline_v1.pdf) and a short DPA template for your review. Key callouts: 

- NDA: kept standard mutual confidentiality language; flagged two clauses for attention (data deletion timeline and evaluation data usage).
- DPA: standard Redwood template with data processing terms and subprocessors listed.

Attachments: redline_v1.pdf (PDF, 12 KB); Redwood_DPA_template.docx (Microsoft Word document, 34 KB)

Next steps: 
- Priya: confirm whether you want us to route directly to Sarah Lin or to send materials to procurement portal first.
- Tom: would you like a 30-minute contract walk-through next week? I can coordinate calendars.

If I don’t hear back by EOD Thursday (2026-07-23), I’ll schedule a brief sync to keep momentum.

Thanks 
Marissa Cole
